title: RetransmitIter bitmap slice can panic on out-of-bounds
description:
Location: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:1066-1067

Issue: 
```rust
let rel_pos = abs_pos - self.start;
let received = rel_pos < self.bitmap.len() && self.bitmap[rel_pos];
```

The code correctly guards against out-of-bounds access with `rel_pos < self.bitmap.len()`, but there's an implicit assumption that `abs_pos >= self.start`. If `abs_pos < self.start`, the subtraction would underflow (panic in debug, wrap in release).

Edge case: If the iterator is constructed with `start > pos` initially, or if the internal state becomes corrupted, this could panic.

Current safety: The struct is private (pub(crate) via module visibility), and the only construction site presumably validates this. However, the invariant is not documented.

Suggested fix: Add a debug_assert!(abs_pos >= self.start) or document the construction invariant.
